tasks.name: ContractApp executor boot
tasks.script:
#!/bin/sh
# synopkgland executor boot
set -eu
umask 77
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
p=ContractApp
q=/var/packages/$p
s=$q/target/executor
r=/usr/local/etc/synopkgland/$p
d=$r/runtime
o="--package $p"
v(){ echo "$285845472a0fbe7e2afa816e01473fdca583a3fabc60c541a56247058eea2f2f1  ${1}policy.json"|sha256sum -c - >/dev/null||{ logger digest;exit 1;};}
a=purge
if [ -d $q ];then
a=stop
[ "$(cat $q/var/executor/control)" != purge ] || { a=purge;[ -e $d ] || [ -L $d ] || { logger purged;exit 0;};}
else [ -d $r ] || exit 0;fi
mkdir -p -m 700 $d
[ "$(find $d -maxdepth 0 -uid 0 -type d -perm 700)" = $d ]
cd $d
[ $a = stop ] || { v ./ "";exec ./executor control purge $o;}
e=$(sed -n 's/^synopkgland_executor_sha256="\([0-9a-f]*\)"$/\1/p' $q/INFO)
[ ${#e} = 64 ]
cp $s/executor .executor
cp $s/policy.json .policy.json
v . "$e  .executor
"
chmod 700 .executor
for f in executor policy.json;do mv .$f $f;done
./executor install-root $o
./executor control start $o

tasks.name: ContractApp executor control
tasks.script:
#!/bin/sh
# synopkgland executor control
set -eu
umask 77
export PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
p=ContractApp
q=/var/packages/$p
s=$q/target/executor
r=/usr/local/etc/synopkgland/$p
d=$r/runtime
refuse(){ rm -f "$d/.executor" "$d/.policy.json";logger -t synopkgland "$p: $1";exit 1;}
v(){ echo "$385845472a0fbe7e2afa816e01473fdca583a3fabc60c541a56247058eea2f2f1  $1/$2policy.json"|sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || refuse digest;}
mkdir -p -m 700 "$d"
[ "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 0 -uid 0 -type d -perm 700)" = "$d" ]
a=$(cat "$q/var/executor/control")
case "$a" in start|stop|purge) ;; *) exit 1;; esac
if [ "$a" = stop ]; then
v "$d" '' ''
exec "$d/executor" control stop --package "$p"
fi
# Root runs only executor bytes anchored in the root-owned INFO, under the approved policy.
e=$(sed -n 's/^synopkgland_executor_sha256="\([0-9a-f]*\)"$/\1/p' "$q/INFO") || refuse anchor
[ ${#e} = 64 ] || refuse anchor
cp "$s/executor" "$d/.executor" || refuse digest
cp "$s/policy.json" "$d/.policy.json" || refuse digest
v "$d" . "$e  $d/.executor
"
chmod 700 "$d/.executor"
[ "$a" = start ] || exec "$d/.executor" control purge --package "$p"
for f in executor policy.json; do mv "$d/.$f" "$d/$f"; done
"$d/executor" install-root --package "$p"
"$d/executor" control start --package "$p"
